comparison.objective: Identify, invert and precisely mount a wafer using tweezers, then enable vacuum; candidate adjusts a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual discrimination, delicate edge-only tweezer handling, regrasp/inversion and 2 mm placement versus hex-key seating, rotary tuning and torque-controlled locking.
comparison.success_condition: Requires correct wafer face-down, centered within 2 mm, flat orientation within 2°, vacuum on and no contamination/drop; candidate requires two safe dynamic stops and retained collar setting.
comparison.reason: This tests delicate semiconductor identification and mounting, not mechanism response calibration.
